newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar, weakens vs pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar, weakens vs pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee was fixed firmer against the dollar but weaker versus the pound on Tuesday, commercial bank forex dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a mean commercial rate of 20.166 against the dollar from 20.194 on Monday. Against the pound, the rupee traded at a mean rate of 32.6275 from 32.3890 on Monday.

Dealers attributed the stronger rupee to a weaker U.S. currency in overnight international markets. They added that the central bank intervened in the interbank forex market by selling dollars to commercial banks on Monday afternoon.
"The intervention was done in response to a shortage in the forex reserves of (commercial) banks," one dealer said.
The dealer added that the shortage situation arose from importers' forex demand exceeding forex inflow from the island's export sectors.
